statement: Wewillbebirds makes bespoke millwork for clients who want more than execution — they want something that couldn't have come from anyone else.
featured_desc: Solid white oak. Fluted front. Designed to occupy space the way a sculpture does — with intention and weight.
cta_subtext: We work with a limited number of clients at a time. Tell us about your space.
service_1_desc: Built-ins, wardrobes, kitchens. Made to the millimeter.
service_2_desc: Consoles, credenzas, bar cabinets. One of a kind.
service_3_desc: Paneling, wall treatments, integrated storage. The full room.
service_4_desc: New York City and surrounding area. White-glove.
